runs.name: resolve
runs.script:
source /usr/lib/openfoam/openfoam2406/etc/bashrc
set -e
mkdir -p /tmp/.OpenFOAM/2406
printf '%s\n' 'InfoSwitches { allowSystemOperations 0; }' > /tmp/.OpenFOAM/2406/controlDict
chmod a-w /tmp/.OpenFOAM/2406/controlDict /tmp/.OpenFOAM/2406 /tmp/.OpenFOAM
grep -qxF 'InfoSwitches { allowSystemOperations 0; }' /tmp/.OpenFOAM/2406/controlDict
cd /case
[ -d 0.orig ] && [ ! -d 0 ] && cp -r 0.orig 0 || true
blockMesh > log.blockMesh 2>&1
icoFoam 2>&1
